about.headline: Crafting visual excellence from digital canvas to industrial production.
about.bio: I am a Graphic Designer and Digital Production Specialist with 8+ years of hands-on experience bridging creative visual design with high-precision industrial manufacturing. Holding a degree in Computer Engineering, I specialize in large-format printing, roll-to-roll dye-sublimation on EPSON F9500 systems, computerized Wilcom embroidery programming, and CNC laser fabrication across Saudi Arabia and Sudan.

services.headline: Industrial Production & Creative Services
services.description: Comprehensive design, roll-to-roll textile sublimation, computerized embroidery, and architectural acrylic fabrication tailored for scale.
